# GenOS Agent Runtime

> GenOS is an open-source runtime for versioned agent state, counterfactual execution, supervised multi-agent orchestration and evidence-aware promotion.

- [Overview](https://genoswork.vercel.app/)
- [Runtime](https://genoswork.vercel.app/runtime)

- [Biological organism map](https://genoswork.vercel.app/systems/organism)
- [Interactive model studio](https://genoswork.vercel.app/lab/models)

## Qualifications

- The eight topology modes are wired to runtime paths, but services and capabilities vary by mode.
- A capability contract does not mean every listed capability is activated in every execution.
- The interactive topology lab is a local illustration, not a live GenOS run.
- Consult the runtime documentation for current implementation status, evidence and known limitations.
